functions.name: compile
functions.description: Compiles a Lua string into a function without executing it. The chunk is loaded under the chunkname `@lje_dynamic_compile` and flagged internally as an LJE proto. Returns `nil` on compilation failure (the error is printed to the console).

returns.description: The compiled function, or a string containing the error message if compilation failed.

functions.name: type
description: Returns the internal LuaJIT fast function ID (`ffid`) of a function.
- Anything else is the unique ID of a fast function.

returns.description: The `ffid` value. `0` for regular Lua functions.
